assets.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Create ONE production animation sprite sheet for an existing cozy illustrated cat restaurant game. The attached images are STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets: image 1 fixes the final pink strawberry donut design; image 2 fixes warm hand-painted cookware, dark brown outlines and shading; image 3 fixes ingredient presentation. True transparent alpha background, no room, no floor, no text, labels, grid lines, shadows outside the objects, or watermarks. Landscape 1536x1024, EXACTLY SIX equally sized square frames in a 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. Each frame repeats the same centered object composition, same scale and camera at three-quarter overhead view, all objects fully contained in its own cell with 12% transparent padding. Six successive slight movements forming a smooth looping sequence; keep the vessel/tabletop-item position fixed. Rich warm cream, moss-green ceramics, wood and berry pink. This is a single small animated game prop, crisp and readable at 64px. SUBJECT: a small rectangular wooden ingredient tray holding a ceramic bowl of flour, milk bottle, egg, butter square, small lidded yeast jar, ripe strawberries and a tiny bowl of powdered sugar. An oval chubby orange cat paw nudges the milk bottle gently, then settles. Tiny flour motes and gentle paw movement across six frames; all the needed donut ingredients visible. No cooked donut yet.
